shortDescription.default: One flow per list. The admin chooses the environment and connection.

longDescription.default: Open AutoGen on a list, choose the column and formula, then pick the Power Automate environment and SharePoint connection. That list gets its own flow. The flow reads AutoGenFlowConfiguration on the site collection and writes the next number.

features.title: AutoGen Flow
features.description: Creates AutoGenFlowConfiguration and adds AutoGen Flow to each list.
